title: Guided reading · round 1
intro: Ruling by Claude Design, 26 Nov 2026 (round 1 plus one follow-up). Five SDUI components for guided code reading in the Agents transcript of a guide session (backlog #1294, #1295), in build order 1 → 2+3 → 4 → 5. The rules are in rules.md and on the Rules board.
Left to the user: (a) the confidence keys vs the choice card's 1–4 options; (b) the length of the send hold (2 s proposed, 0 = no hold).
First the final set, then the round as the designer first drew it (directions A/B/C side by side); those boards are in design/features/guided-reading/rounds/.

boards.title: 1–3 · Ask and reveal · Mac 1280 Mate dark
boards.caption: Free pick in the card (a pick never sends); the chip sends with a 2 s hold and ⌘Z; the card turns into the record in place. Side panes: lettered lines, pick in nvim, separate verdict card, chips + Send.

boards.title: 4 + 5 · Step controls and concept map · Mac 1280 Mate dark
boards.caption: Controls under the latest step only, hidden while a question is open; no permanent Next. Map = Tour tab next to Context when the main column is ≥ 960 px.

boards.title: 1–5 · Mac 640 Mate light
boards.caption: Peek shows six lines around the cursor; the bar keeps the pick; the map becomes the header strip with a popover.

boards.title: 1–3 · iPhone dark and light
boards.caption: Tap a line, ▲ ▼ to nudge, Line / Range segment; a confidence capsule sends; Open on Mac replaces nvim.
